test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Success demands hard work, __diligence__ and perseverance.
solution:
The correct answer is **Effort.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **diligence__** refers to *careful, consistent, and sustained effort* in carrying out a task.
 
• In the given sentence, diligence is used alongside *hard work* and *perseverance*, reinforcing the idea of continuous effort.
 
• **Effort** is the closest synonym as it conveys purposeful and sustained hard work.
 
• The other options do not match the meaning of diligence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Indolence**: laziness (antonym of diligence).
 
• **Coolness**: calmness or lack of emotion.
 
• **Trouble**: difficulty or problem.
